packageRules.description: Strapi 5 is a migration, not an update: no @strapi package above 4, security alerts included (allowedVersions filters the versions those alerts can pick). The v3 replaces Strapi

Security fixes only: no update of any kind (version, pin, digest or replacement of a deprecated package) outside a security alert (those go through vulnerabilityAlerts, which overrides this rule). Strapi 4 stays on Node 20 and on its 4.26 line
Pinned for the Strapi 4 admin panel
